boundary: Use neutral monomers. The torsion is the signed C-S-N-C dihedral; report the convention used and preserve its sign. Z is one near-trans state identity spanning both sides of the periodic +/-180-degree boundary; torsion_regions_deg is the union of the listed closed intervals. The state regions identify the three requested state identities, not expected energies.

primary_thermochemistry.energy: Electronic energy plus Grimme quasi-RRHO Gibbs thermal correction at 298.15 K and 1 atm, using vibrational-entropy interpolation with reference frequency 100 cm^-1 consistently for all six states. Keep rotational/symmetry conventions explicit.
primary_thermochemistry.relative_reference: Subtract the lowest G separately for each molecule; report Z-minus-lowest and the V+/V- gap separately.
primary_thermochemistry.other_conditions: Additional media/thermal treatments are sensitivity results, not interchangeable primary values.
